title: The Lost Key
intro: You wake up in a dim stone room with no memory of how you got here.

room.text: A cold stone room. There's a wooden door to the north and a small chest in the corner.

chest.text: Inside the chest you find a rusty key.

door_locked.text: The door is locked tight. You'll need a key.

door_unlock.text: The rusty key turns with a satisfying click. The door creaks open onto a sunlit hallway.

hallway.text: Freedom! Sunlight streams in. You made it out of the stone room.
